messages:
Sara: Quick proposal — group the main left rail into two lanes: 'Workflows' (Models, Pipelines, Jobs, Deployments) and 'Org' (Billing, Members, Settings). Add per-panel permalinks so product pages can link directly to a specific sub-view. Thoughts? :eyes:

Dmitri: I like the lane idea, but move 'Deployments' under Workflows not Org. Org should stay administrative only.

Alex: Permalinks sound great. For routing I prefer pathname-based routes (/app/:org/:space/:flow/:panel) over hash fragments. Cleaner for sharing and browser history. Back-button behavior must be preserved though.

Maya: Accessibility nit — if permalinks jump to a deep panel, ensure keyboard focus lands on the panel heading and we announce the navigation via a live region. Also add skiplinks to jump to primary content.

Tom: Routing concern: pathname approach means we need server-side redirects for legacy hash URLs. How do we plan backwards compatibility for older links and emails?

Sara: Good call. Proposed plan: accept both but canonicalize to pathname. Add a redirect middleware that maps /#/x -> /x. Rollout behind a feature flag and canary for 2 weeks.

Dmitri: Can we get a short mapping table for the middleware? Old -> new examples would help the infra team.

Alex: Quick mapping snippet to start with:
```
#/models -> /app/:org/models
#/models/model-:id -> /app/:org/models/:id
#/pipelines -> /app/:org/pipelines
#/jobs/:id/logs -> /app/:org/jobs/:id/logs
```

Maya: Also propose keyboard mnemonics: press 'g' then 'm' to go to Models, 'g' then 'p' for Pipelines. Make sure those don't conflict with existing editor shortcuts.

Tom: Rollout checklist: feature flag + telemetry events (nav_click, permalink_open). Watch back-button usage, 404 spike, and redirect latency.

Sara: UX follow-ups: tweak breadcrumb root to show the org name instead of generic 'Home', use smaller chevrons for better screen-reader ordering, and ensure hover targets meet 40px minimum touch size. I'll add these to the PR.

Alex: Minor: make the permalink copy-to-clipboard button keyboard-accessible and visible on focus/hover. Include a visual hint that the link includes filters/query params.

Dmitri: :thumbsup: Add me to the dev PR for the routing middleware — I'll handle the redirect rules.

deploy-bot: Deployed redirect-middleware:staging at 1792345800

Sara: Thanks — I'm adding test cases to the ticket: keyboard nav, screen reader announce, focus landing, canonical redirect, and query param preservation.

Maya: One more: docs update — show examples and note that permalinks preserve query params for filters and sorts. Also mention expected a11y behavior.

Tom: Agreed. I'll add telemetry keys and a small SLO: redirect latency <200ms for 99th percentile.

Sara: Next step: I'll open the RFC doc and ping eng-frontend + accessibility. Filing now: https://r.redwood.ai/r/1234

Alex: LGTM

Dmitri: LG

Maya: lgtm :tiny_orange_diamond:

Sara: Thanks everyone — will follow up once RFC PR is up.
